items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: It's like writing for Aaron Neville's Iron Man Thomas. You can write for them without stopping.

ctx.x: You had written Java a couple of years before, about five years before that, for yourself, hadn't you? And then that was picked up by All Herb.

Right. Right. Right. Actually, in the writing of Whipped Cream, one thing that did make Whipped Cream a bit unique from the other tunes right in that same year of instrumentals, I did have Al Hurt in mind after he had did Java. I hadn't thought of Java for a trumpet or anything. And Al Hurt did inspire a lot of songs. It's easier to write what Al Hurt in mind. You can write forever. It's like writing for Aaron Neville's Iron Man Thomas. You can write for them without stopping.
After you got out of the Army, didn't the All For One group get together with Harold and Batiste? Was that pretty soon after that?
